_doc: Task 614 — WHERE DOES A BIB ENTRY END? Both Python silos answer `cases`: editor/scripts/bib_resolve.find_entry_span (editor/scripts/tests/test_bib_entry_span_parity.py) and library/scripts/_bib_parse.find_entry_span (library/scripts/tests/test_bib_entry_span_parity.py). `expect` is the verbatim entry text, null (no such entry), or "refuse" (the entry exists but its extent can't be trusted, so a splice must not happen). Task 884 — ONE entry-head rule: an opener starts a line after optional indentation (`^[ \t]*@type{key,`), the span starts at that line, and the editor's presence check (`all_citekeys`) answers the same rows. `vbid` — WHICH ENTRY DOES A \vbid{uid} MARKER NAME? `uid` is what the app's `parseVbidMarkers` (src/lib/__tests__/bib-entry-span-vbid.test.ts) and the skill-side port `citekey_sidecars.vbid_uid_for` both return for `citekey` (null = unbound).
